{{Quote|She's a good kid&mdash;wild after hours&mdash;but always shows up on time for work.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Interview">{{InsiderCite|65|Insider Interview|''Insider'' Interview: Dexter Jettster}}</ref>}}
'''Hermione Bagwa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] brought up in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] rescued her from the filthy streets, giving her a job in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. She was always a favorite among the customers, and went on to become the diner's head waitress.

==Biography==
===Early life in poverty===
Hermione was born into desperate poverty in the filthy lower levels of Coruscant. Her childhood years were lonesome, full of squalor and misery. It was not until her teenage years that [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] stumbled across her. He felt sorry for the young woman. At the time, he was in need of a waitress for his diner, and offered Hermione the job. This was nothing short of salvation for the young teenager. From that point on, she was deeply loyal to Dexter.<ref name="FF60" /> When asked, Dexter sometimes said that Hermione's father was an old friend, and that he had promised to look after her.<ref name="Interview" />

===Head waitress===
As the head waitress, Hermione was in charge of Dex's motley crew of assistant droids.<ref name="FF54">{{FactFile|54|COR 23-26|Coruscant &ndash; Dex's Diner}}</ref> She took customers' orders by dictating them into a stylus which she stored in a garter on her thigh. The stylus was attached to an [[order comm]] worn on her belt, which transmitted the orders to the kitchen.<ref name="FF60" /> She also brought customers their meals.

Although she loved working at the diner, it was not without its troubles. Even though Hermione was head waitress, her fellow [[FLO/Legends|WA-7]] waitress droid disliked having to work under an inexperienced organic waitress. The jealous droid did everything it could to undermine Hermione's position.<ref name="FF60" /> WA-7 would often try to run over Hermione's toes, forcing her to wear very durable leather boots. In response, Hermione would sometimes set up traps around the diner to trip WA-7 up.<ref name="FF64">{{FactFile|64|WAI 1-2|WA-7 Waitress Droid}}</ref>

[[File:Hermioneface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bagwa&mdash;the customers' favorite]]
Hermione was a favorite among the working-class patrons. She usually wore an old-fashioned light-blue dress at the diner. She presented herself in a way that always gained the customers' attention, and was soon known to be one of [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town's]] beauties. Many of the diner's regulars kept coming back just for Hermione's good company.<ref name="FF60" /> Her employer believed her to be "wild after hours."<ref name="Interview" />

With her tough upbringing, Hermione was also very capable of dealing with troublesome customers. Her large black leather boots reminded customers that she was not one to be trifled with. She also had the option of calling Dex out of the kitchen with her order comm if the going got too rough.<ref name="FF60" />

===Brushes with glory===
Hermione was working in the diner at the time that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited Dexter in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] regarding a mysterious [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]], though it was WA-7 that served him a cup of [[Ardees/Legends|Jawa juice]].<ref name="AoTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

When [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] and [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] visited the diner in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] for information on a female [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] assassin, Hermione was serving [[slider]]s, [[Ardees/Legends|ardees]] and [[slider garnish]] to some customers.<ref name="Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

At some point, presumably after the diner was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="LastoftheJedi">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref> and later rebuilt, an aging but friendly Hermione owned and operated the diner after Dexter presumably retired throughout most of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
Hermione Bagwa wore a light blue [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with the logo of Dex's Diner. The dresses style harked back to an earlier [[Time/Legends|time]]. Alongside the dress, she wore black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] which protected her from toxic kitchen slops, and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. An [[Order comm/Legends|order comm]], which was attached to her belt, featured a voice reader, a retaining cord, and a record stylus strapped to her leg with a sliver band. She also wore silver [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelets]] and a silver hair tie.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hermioneconcept.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Hermione Bagwa concept art by [[Dermot Power]]]]
Hermione Bagwa was portrayed by Australian actress [[Susie Porter]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']]. Hermione's appearance was conceptualized by artist [[Dermot Power]].<ref name="DB" />

Earlier drafts of the screenplay had Bagwa being Dexter's wife, but this notion was eventually abandoned. Susie Porter delivered the dialog seen in the film both for Bagwa and WA-7, but it was only WA-7 who ended up with all the lines in the final film script.<ref name="DB" />
